fusions.name: Creeping Rust
fusions.desc: Fires a spore that deals 28 necrotic damage, ignoring armour, leaves the target [Sundered] for 8 seconds and gives it Rot for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flake and Spall
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Sheds a layer of fungal plate that deals 9 necrotic damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and gives them Rot for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bracket Shell
fusions.desc: Grows a shell that absorbs the next 20 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second at all times.

fusions.name: Regrown Layers
fusions.desc: When a blow that is not fire damages you, you gain a ward worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
